verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs say API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, with a single Bearer header, so API parity with the UI follows from the architecture. A built-in Swagger surface documents those endpoints, but the REST reference is declared experimental and only appears in dev mode, with no REST deprecation window. missing for 10: a stable, non-experimental REST API contract, a published OpenAPI spec reachable without ENV=dev (probes for openapi.json returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of feature-by-feature parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
